title.en: Mountain coverages based on Sayre et al., 2014

abstract.en: Mountain coverages based on the the work by Sayre et al., 2014 (ELU = Ecological Land Units; LF = (physical) Land (surface) Features). Data obtained from the Ilias universität Bern (https://ilias.unibe.ch/goto_ilias3_unibe_cat_1029094.html).

notes.en:
• Theme/title: Mountain coverages based on Sayre et al., 2014.
  • Compiled for the Sustainable Caucasus GeoNode -> MapX publication workflow.
  • Raster values encode the thematic variable described in the abstract; check units before analysis.
  • Verify licensing, citation, and fitness-for-purpose with the original data provider before redistribution.
